scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend/nexus run dev"
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:seed
scripts.install: npm install --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/nexus install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:integration && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
